tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Recalculates a calculator card after the user changes a value. Used by the card itself, not by the assistant.

tools.name: run_calculator
tools.description: Runs one Calcupedia calculator with its verified formulas. Returns every result, a link that opens the calculator with the same values, and the inputs it accepts with their current values. Use it for finance, health, math, date and unit-conversion questions that need exact figures the user can check
